correctionNotes: Preserve the 1–3 kHz vocal core: its forward, natural and organic midrange is the defining strength, so avoid generic presence boosts or broad mid cuts.
Sub-bass is quality-first and track-dependent while mid-bass is already punchy and textured; use only a very small deep-bass lift and keep upper-bass cleanup subtle.
Treble is extended and energetic but generally smooth; use sub-1 dB edge/sibilance trimming only, retaining air above 10 kHz.
At 8 ohms / 116 dB this IEM is source-sensitive; use a low-output-impedance X8 headphone path and keep gain/volume conservative.
signature: Natural warm-neutral/W-shaped 5-BA wood IEM with an intimate, organic vocal-led midrange, textured fast bass, realistic note body, and lively but controlled airy treble.
